trigger: async/irreversible file write (user Markdown overwritten on save) + new serializers

doubts.disproof_attempt: Image.configure allowBase64:false drops a data: URI image on load; no lossy warning.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: allowBase64 true plus a data-URI round-trip test.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A GFM table cell serializes everything it contains
doubts.disproof_attempt: serializeTable writes a cell only when textContent.trim() is non-empty; an image-only or hard-break-only cell is emptied.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Use childCount for emptiness; test image-only and badge-link cells.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Pipes in table cells are always escaped correctly
doubts.disproof_attempt: The lookbehind skips a pipe preceded by a backslash, but a literal backslash is itself escaped to two backslashes so the pipe stays bare and splits the cell.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Escape every pipe in cell output unconditionally; add tests for a backslash next to a pipe and a pipe in a code span.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Forcing tight lists for task lists is harmless
doubts.disproof_attempt: Tight forcing may collapse multi-paragraph task items; a mixed task/plain list may drop or rewrite an item.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Round-trip tests for multi-paragraph item, nested bullet, code block in item, loose list, mixed list.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Non-GFM tables fall back to lossless HTML
doubts.disproof_attempt: outerHTML is written with raw newlines: inside a list/quote later lines lose the container prefix, and a blank line ends the HTML block early.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Collapse newlines to character references; tests for table in list/quote and code block in a cell.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Inline images serialize as valid Markdown
doubts.disproof_attempt: A src with a space is written unwrapped and is invalid on re-read; markdown-it percent-encodes destinations.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Wrap the destination in angle brackets when it has whitespace or parens; document percent-encoding.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A code block round-trips and the info string is safe
doubts.disproof_attempt: Only the first word of the info string survives; a tilde fence with a backtick in the language becomes an invalid backtick fence.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Lossy-warning rule for extra info-string words; tilde fence when the language contains a backtick.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The mermaid preview is isolated and leak-free
doubts.disproof_attempt: No script path found; render id collides for identical blocks mounted in the same millisecond; orphan error svgs; eager rendering of many diagrams.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Unique render id; lazy rendering optional.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: CRLF, size and mixed-EOL are handled
doubts.disproof_attempt: state.inTable is not reset when renderInline throws.

summary: 2 high, 5 medium, 2 low. Implementer must fix or rebut each in writing.
